vectors.name: granted_call
vectors.why: Only this sequence produces the value an action requires. The grant's ID is the hash of its payload.

vectors.name: self_issued_grant
vectors.why: A fooled agent can't grant itself anything.

vectors.name: grant_from_a_host_key
vectors.why: No host can issue a grant, so gate 5 holds with the host compromised.

vectors.name: other_agents_grant
vectors.why: A grant is useless without the holder's key.

vectors.name: another_resource
vectors.why: A grant is for one resource.

vectors.name: another_operation
vectors.why: A grant names the operations it allows, and a resource asks about one.

vectors.name: proof_for_another_resource
vectors.why: Same for the proof.

vectors.name: proof_by_another_key
vectors.why: Only the holder's key.

vectors.name: proof_for_another_body
vectors.why: A captured proof can't ask something else.

vectors.name: stale_proof
vectors.why: Proofs live for 120 seconds.

vectors.name: future_dated_proof
vectors.why: Either way.

vectors.name: proof_naming_another_signer
vectors.why: The proof must name the holder it's signed by.

vectors.name: proof_for_another_method
vectors.why: A proof fits one method.

vectors.name: proof_for_another_path
vectors.why: And one path.

vectors.name: unknown_grant_version
vectors.why: An unknown version is refused.

vectors.name: grant_naming_another_owner
vectors.why: The owner it names must be the one that signed it.

vectors.name: grant_dated_ahead
vectors.why: A grant can't be dated ahead to start later than the owner meant.

vectors.name: expired_grant
vectors.why: Grants end.

vectors.name: life_too_long
vectors.why: At most 30 days.

vectors.name: operations_out_of_order
vectors.why: Sorted with no repeats, so one grant has one encoding.

vectors.name: operation_as_prose
vectors.why: An operation is a word the resource chose.

vectors.name: no_rate
vectors.why: Every grant has a rate.

vectors.name: no_nonce
vectors.why: A nonce keeps two alike grants apart, so revoking one leaves the other.

vectors.name: revoked
vectors.why: A revocation goes straight to the resource, so no host can hold it back.

vectors.name: over_the_rate
vectors.why: Calls per hour are capped.

vectors.name: revocation
vectors.why: The signature is what counts, so it's accepted from anyone.

vectors.name: revocation_by_the_agent_key
vectors.why: An agent can't revoke, or a fooled one could stall its owner.

vectors.name: revocation_naming_no_grant
vectors.why: It names a grant by its ID.
